headline: ChatGPT adds virtual clothing try-on feature
summary: OpenAI rolled out a ChatGPT feature that lets users virtually try on clothing and accessories using their own photos, generated with OpenAI's latest model, and save favorites for later.

claims.statement: OpenAI added a ChatGPT feature letting users virtually try on clothing and accessories using their own photos.

sources.quote: OpenAI is rolling out new shopping features for ChatGPT that let users virtually try on clothing and accessories using their own photos and save products they like to a Favorites library.
ChatGPT can now help you virtually try on clothes

claims.statement: Users can save clothes they like to a Favorites library for later.

sources.quote: Images are generated with OpenAI's latest model and you can save clothes you like for later.
